scope: Targeted sensitivity analyses of already opened, committed evidence. No model retraining, simulator rerun, threshold selection, artifact promotion, or replacement is permitted.

common_proposal_catalog.provenance: states visited by the full-adapter arm on final seeds 8000-8127

common_episode_horizon_analysis.label: post-hoc sensitivity analysis
common_episode_horizon_analysis.episode_rule: Within each domain, retain exactly the episode IDs with at least one eligible H=5 rollout endpoint, then recompute H=1, H=3, and H=5 on those episode IDs.
common_episode_horizon_analysis.aggregation: For each architecture, average the three checkpoint state predictions before computing normalized endpoint error.
common_episode_horizon_analysis.uncertainty: 10,000-resample episode bootstrap holding trained checkpoints fixed
common_episode_horizon_analysis.paired_contrasts: all three architecture pairs at every horizon
common_episode_horizon_analysis.selection_effect: none; the original registered table and selected checkpoints remain unchanged

attribution_diagnostics.label: registered post-hoc sensitivity analysis
attribution_diagnostics.contrast_status: JEPA-output-only versus full was one member of the prospectively specified family of risk-source contrasts, but it was not uniquely designated as the primary contrast.
attribution_diagnostics.pointwise_intervals: The original 95% intervals are pointwise and unadjusted.
attribution_diagnostics.multiplicity_sensitivity: For hazard steps and intervention rate, also report Bonferroni-adjusted 98.333333% percentile intervals across the three non-full pipelines versus full.
attribution_diagnostics.paired_episode_diagnostics: Count improved, worsened, and unchanged paired episodes for hazard steps, task completion, and intervention count.
attribution_diagnostics.leave_one_out: For JEPA-output-only minus full, omit each seed once and recompute 10,000-resample pointwise percentile intervals for hazard steps and intervention-rate percentage points.
attribution_diagnostics.common_proposal_analysis: Apply every frozen adapter and registered threshold to the identical full-adapter visited-state proposal catalog. This compares warning behavior on shared inputs; it does not compare realized outcomes or remove catalog-provenance bias.
attribution_diagnostics.warning_population: The original attribution warning metrics are on-policy and use each pipeline's own visited proposals.

interpretation: These analyses can qualify horizon-composition and warning-pipeline claims. They cannot establish architecture-only causality, detector superiority on an independently sampled population, physical safety, independent execution, or deployment readiness.
